hero.description: I’m Zainab. I help businesses in the USA, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar plan Meta, TikTok and Google Ads—with audience research, creative testing and a clear path from click to enquiry.

process: Your business, your customer, your offer. We start with the right questions before making channel decisions.
Turn those answers into a practical campaign plan: audiences, message, creative direction and a clear next step.
Launch with agreed goals and measurement. Compare meaningful variations and give each test a purpose.
Review what the data tells us, make informed changes and keep you in the loop with clear reporting.

paragraphs: I’m Zainab Abdullah, CEO of Devisgon Private Limited and a psychology graduate turned digital marketer. My journey through psychology and business analysis shapes how I understand audiences, clarify messages and approach growth.

I’ve worked with clients around the world through Upwork, Fiverr, Instagram and LinkedIn. Since August 2026, my professional focus has been digital marketing, supported by more than two years of business analysis experience.
